At irregular intervals, SCP-7598's primary anomalous trait will manifest in the form of a questioning event, whereupon it will state the following in a cheerful, high-pitched tone: "Excuse me! Would this be a good time to explode?"

The conceptual linking, and therefore complete control over the concepts of fire, darkness, and death.

SCP-7618 is a cognitohazardous variation of fog, occurring in approximately 10% of all recorded instances.
When a subject stands in SCP-7618, they will experience a brief hallucination of their possible futures. These futures are vague and largely defined through brief flashes and strong, emotional reactions. Despite the lack of evidence, all subjects will fully believe in the accuracy and possibility of these hallucinations.

SCP-7820 is a seamount in the Arctic Ocean, 38 kilometers from the geographic North Pole. The peak of the seamount is 100 meters below the surface, but erosion on its upper portion indicates that it was above sea level until around 10,000 years ago.
From ~44,000 BCE to ~39,000 BCE, SCP-7820 was home to a civilization of Homo neanderthalensis maritimus.

Dear Dr. Peterson,

When used at night by a subject, regardless of experience with the instrument, they will perform a series of disconnected melodies. During this session, the Moon, regardless of location or visibility, will appear to move closer to the Earth.
The physical distance between the Earth and Moon will not change, however, the local area around SCP-7915 will experience the gravitational effects of the approaching Moon.

The only known case of SCP-7919 was identified in Agent Mahoni during a routine medical examination after an unrelated mission. data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-7938 was a supposed reality-bending temporal anomaly that occurred between July 18, 1978 - October 18, 1978. SCP-7938 consisted of SCP-7938-A, known as "Anatoly Karpov", and SCP-7938-B, known as "Viktor Korchnoi". The hypothesized manifestation of SCP-7938 is believed to have been contingent on the competition of both SCP-7938-A and SCP-7938-B in the 1978 World Chess Championship.

This ceiling will block the upward movement of SCP-7940 and inanimate objects it is holding, but is completely intangible to other living beings.

The amount of time experienced by affected individuals varies, but tasks that would normally take seconds are generally perceived as lasting months or years. It is widely considered the thus-far supreme accomplishment of the Foundation’s Department of Genetics’ Experimental Division, having achieved or succeeded all milestones of mental development equivalent to human children in its youth. Further information is available upon request.

SCP-8166 is a music box formerly possessed by PoI-1875, Hans Christian Andersen, a Danish author known for writing fairy tales and suspected thaumaturge. It is decorated with a medallion of a crane bird and the inscription "Eden".

It exhibits a great deal of control over its shape, consistency, and motion, allowing it to flow through apertures as small as 0.1 millimeters in diameter, move up to 43 kilometers per hour, and become sufficiently rigid to climb vertical surfaces.

The most prominent instance of SCP-8173 amplifies the normalcy of Ms Audrey Harrier (see addenda). This instance is also responsible for paradoxes relating to her physiology, life history, behaviour, and origin. These paradoxes are functions of the semiohazard and their effect on normalcy. It is defined by the collocation of the words “lily” and “gristle” at levels far higher than chance or idiomatic expression would permit. It is suspected that the city itself, due to its rich cultural and historic traditions, is directly responsible for this effect. Due to the size of the city and its population, containment has proved exceedingly difficult.

SCP-8711 is a spatial-temporal displacement phenomenon and pocket dimension that primarily affects maritime vessels and aircraft traveling towards the rising sun on any given Sunday.1 Vessels affected by SCP-8711 are instantaneously removed from material reality, disappearing from all known means of detection.
Vessels and aircraft affected by SCP-8711 reappear in coastal waters filled with extensive rock formations and reef prone shoals surrounding a large island landmass dubbed SCP-8711-1. This

SCP-8712-A is a series of journals written in by POI-1930707, "Dr. John H. Watson", recounting his discovery of SCP-8712-B, and his involvement in Incident 8712-1, notably seeming to involve an anomalous GOI. SCP-8712-A-1 is one such journal, and the only one recovered to date. SCP-8712-A-1 was circumstantially recovered from the London Library by agents searching for background information on SCP-████. Cross-reference with similar journals published in British publication "The Strand Magazine"

SCP-8713 events are presented as live art performances. The content of each event is highly variable and consistently falls outside of what might be expected from such performances. Consistent factors of events include the presence of POI-8713, as well as witnesses being unable to conceive of concepts such as “horror”, “atrocity” and “bad art” for the duration. As a result, actions carried out as part of an SCP-8713 event are always received positively, regardless of societal or artistic merit.

SCP-8714 is a collection of objects retrieved from the estate belonging to the late Lord Alexander Brandt III,2 in Northumberland, UK. The SCP-8714 collection was found in a chamber behind a hidden door in the manor's basement after a fire consumed the property, resulting in Lord Brant's demise.

SCP-8715 is a 1.23-litre, black ceramic vase of indeterminate origin. When any liquid is introduced into the object, it is anomalously diminished at a rate inconsistent with any known form of natural evaporation or absorption.
Due to its perceived harmlessness and negligible anomalous properties, SCP-8715 is currently permitted to remain in the common area as directed by Site-94's administrative authority.

SCP-8717 is a fountain pen of luxury quality named “Libra”, housed in a mahogany gift box, using a standard piston converter made of reinforced glass to contain the ink.

SCP-8718 is an anomalous species of vine native to the Republic of South Africa suspected to be from the genus, Ceropegia. The species is currently unidentified, but is visually similar to Ceropegia ampliata.
SCP-8718 is capable of electrogenesis. Study indicates lower electricity production at night suggesting the process is an advanced form of photosynthesis. The flowers of SCP-8718 are non-anomalous.

SCP-8719 is a parasite which inhibits human fear responses by attacking the amygdala and hypothalamus. It reproduces asexually in most mammals, but only causes behavioral changes in Homo sapiens. Risk factors include tainted blood, organ transplants, and undercooked meat.

SCP-8745 is not a bird.
It possesses no wings, no feathers and no beak. It does not fly. It cannot build a nest. It does not vocalize in chirps, calls or songs. It does not lay eggs. It bears none of the associated traits of a bird.
Birds do not have fingers. Birds lack teeth. Their grin does not stretch beyond the confines of their biology. Birds are pure, untainted creatures.1

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-8747 refers to the anomalously enforced inability for all anomalous objects, and digital data to be deleted from technological systems. All efforts to expunge or overwrite reference data remains ineffective. Despite its characteristics, the anomaly appears to have no effect against written material, other non-digital media, and its existence has theorized to have been manufactured by the creation of SCP-8747-A.

When SCP-8748 is inserted into an open wound and rotated by hand, blood in the affected vascular region is rapidly transformed into dense whipped cream. This substance is chemically similar to dairy whipped topping, though it possesses an unusually rich texture and noticeably sweeter taste than conventional whipped cream.

data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-8784 is an ontokinetic2 spatial anomaly localised entirely within Site-874's twenty four hour automated cafeteria. From an outside perspective, Site-874's cafeteria appears normal and uncontaminated. Individuals who enter the area will vanish from view. Those who enter SCP-8784's area appear within the anomaly's interior, entering through an open door, despite it not being visible prior. SCP-8785 is a butter chicken curry intended to have been consumed by Dr. Smith for lunch. Accounts of SCP-8785’s flavor profile have been erratic throughout testing, with only Dr. Smith having been capable of offering a consistent description of the true nature of SCP-8785. Whether or not SCP-8785 is sentient and specifically challenges Dr. Smith’s ability or elects to spare other Foundation personnel is unknown and is subject of further testing.

All observed events have later been determined to have entirely mundane explanations, however the frequency at which these events occur still warrant investigation.

SCP-9197 spreads if someone sees the death of an SCP-9197-A instance, both self-inflicted or by another individual. The illness can be first detected mere minutes after infection, however, it only takes full effect around 24 hours following initial exposure. SCP-9198 refers to a hostile, hivemind-like organism that visually mimics the appearance of snow. Its diet primarily consists of siphoning any nearby sources of thermal energy and organic matter, which it utilizes to replicate on a massive scale. Despite its potential to trigger an NK-Class (“Grey Goo”) Scenario, SCP-9198 is currently contained within the confines of Montreal Island in Canada, effectively preventing a global catastrophe.

data.descriptionExcerpt: URA-7DL is a bipedal chimerical entity, origin unknown, estimated to be two meters in height. It is composed of bodily features from a ram, tortoise, baboon, crab, scorpion, ox, and snakes. URA-7DL is capable of emitting sarin gas, and has been reported to flay and devour children, using their skin as clothing. Prior to Foundation discovery, it had been sighted seven kilometers southwest of ████████, but its current whereabouts are unknown.

SCP-9200 is a crashed spacefaring5 vessel located in Makronisos, Greece. SCP-9200's operating artificial intelligence (known hereafter as SCP-9200-A) is functioning and has been since the ship first crashed into the island over 3000 years ago. The vessel has suffered catastrophic damage to its hull and major systems. SCP-9201 is the Foundation Reality Transaction Manager (FRTM), a piece of paratechnology which enables ACID transaction processing on a piece of local reality. Due to its immense power requirements and the difficulty of properly determining conceptual parameters, effective use for Foundation operations is challenging.
The primary use of the FRTM is in SCP-9201-A, the Foundation Field Anomaly Analyzer (FFAA). This 47 kilogram device interfaces with an internally-installed limited-use SCP-9201 ins

SCP-9202 is a worldwide network, thaumaturgic in nature, that allows for parsing and transmission of emotion and subconscious intent at a higher rate than would be normally possible. SCP-9202 is responsible for the level of advanced reasoning and coordination required for modern civilization. SCP-9202 originates from thaumochemical reactions inside of the human brain.

Discovered in Whistlebay, Wyoming in 1992 following a number of sightings and reports of kidnappings by the entity. Moved to Site-19 following negotiations.

This retrieval is uninhibited by distance, size, and other factors that would normally limit feasibility. A minority of requests result in retrieval of an object other than the one requested. The significance of non-target objects retrieved is unknown.

SCP-9212-D was an anomalous humanoid resembling a middle aged Native American male. It was a thaumaturgist capable of teleportation, transfiguration, and spontaneous energy manifestation.

Initial copies, of which there were two, were illegible, consisting primarily of fragmented multilingual text with no identifiable author. No coherent intent was detected.
We did not exist yet.

The non-anomalous tradition, practiced in Britain and once in the United States of America, involves a wedded couple convincing a ceremonial jury that they have not regretted their marriage for a year; successful claimants swear a specific “flitch oath” and are awarded a flitch of bacon (hence the name “flitch trials”). Knowles wrote in his report that the masks had been found near the village of Poporo with their rims caked in what appeared to have been dried blood.

SCP-9335 infects any living organism that makes direct contact with its spines. Initial symptoms will occur after six hours and proceed in four stages.

Origin is unknown, but both were discovered during an FBI raid on a meeting of the Valdez and Konstantinidis supermarket syndicates at a Dyker Heights restaurant in Brooklyn. They were found huddled in a storage room.

Operation LEANDER confirmed that competitors are translocated during this time to SCP-9337-A (See Addendum-1). data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-9338 is, in its current form, an indestructible,1 static, cuboid block of wood, measuring 50cm x 80cm x 120cm.2 While impossible to sample, the majority of experts have agreed the wood belongs to the species pinus tabuliformis var. tabuliformis.3 Apart from its indestructibility, SCP-9338 exhibits identical physical traits to any other cuboid of wood of the same presumed species.

SCP-9339 are the consequences of a declaration made by the Bishop of Rome, Vicar of Jesus Christ, Successor of the Prince of Apostles, Supreme Pontiff of the One Most Holy Apostolic and Catholic Church, Innocent XI, as concerns the novel practice of “going steady”, i.e. engaging in romantic relations outside of marriage (or indeed even as its intended predecessor). This practice had been growing in popularity among new adults in the West, especially those in the Union State of America, since aro

SCP-9340 are a collection of 71 3-dimensional cross-sections of 4-dimensional simplices, formed of an unknown nonbaryonic material. On examination, they appear to be tablets of slate-coloured stone, which perpetually emit smoke. Their surfaces are etched with a variety of pictograms, which anomalously convey a unique message when read. Comprehension of these messages induces one of the strongest agnostic effects known to the Foundation. Personnel bear the responsibility of understanding.

Item 9342 is engraved with the word ‘RETRACTARE’1 and was formerly connected to the wall opposite it by seven chains comprised of an anomalous alloy; three were broken on discovery and the remaining four were visibly failing, indicating Item 9342 was being pulled outward by a constant, steady force. SCP-9343-1 refers to a variety of structures and buildings built in the style of 12th century architecture. SCP-9343-1 instances usually take the form of a church or statue, however one recorded instance of it taking the form of a full settlement has been discovered. Islands affected by SCP-9344 evolve towards a specific template, with changes occurring to their geography, settlement, businesses, and population according to a regular pattern. This process takes between 15-30 months, tending to occur more quickly on islands with larger numbers of visitors. data.titleJP: The Incorrupt Head of Susana Méndez
data.descriptionExcerpt:
SCP-9345 is a severed human head and neck belonging to a woman identified as Susana Méndez Aguilar. Despite its current state, it exhibits no signs of putrefaction or decay. All samples collected from SCP-9345 regenerate almost immediately after tissue is removed; the limits of this regeneration have not been tested due to the value of the anomaly and concerns about inflicting irreparable damage.
SCP-9345’s main anomalous effect is triggered when a drop of human blood is introduced in its mouth.

SCP-9346 is an estuarine black mangove1 island located near Site-101's aquaflora containment wing. SCP-9346 hosts a variety of terrestrial and marine flora and fauna expected of a microhabitat of its kind (see containment document 9346.02 for a detailed report on SCP-9346's biota).

SCP-9348 is a large humanoid entity located in the eastern Mediterranean Sea, the location of which is designated Location-9348. SCP-9348 is primarily mechanical in nature, utilizing complex mechanical structures to move its body.
Although the entity’s material appears to resemble metals such as brass, iron, and gold, the actual makeup of the entity is biological, as recovered samples have shown the material to be cellular in nature. Furthermore, these cellular structures appear to function as e

data.titleJP: The Horse, the Homestead, and the Huntsman
data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-9349 was a domestic horse (Equus ferus caballus) which seemingly possessed human-level intelligence and was anomalously capable of speech. The entity claimed to have once been a human transformed into its current form by thaumaturgy. As SCP-9349 was never fully within Foundation custody, further information is limited largely to the entity’s own unverified claims.

SCP-9350 refers to a phenomenon affecting Warwick Castle, in Warwick, England. Exclusively during night hours, approximately once per 10-21 days, an SCP-9350 event will occur within the castle and its grounds (hereby dubbed a “revelry event”).
During revelry events, Warwick Castle becomes host to an immense, crowded and chaotic party, facilitated by the spontaneous appearance of ~250-1000+ inebriated, hyperactive party guests (collectively dubbed SCP-9350-1). Extensive genealogy has proved SCP-9

data.titleJP: Let Our Sorrows Blossom Into Beautiful Flowers
data.descriptionExcerpt: SCP-9351 refers to a subspecies of Centaurea cyanus1 found within the Champagne-Ardenne region of France. It has been noted that SCP-9351 instances produce pollen containing an anomalous disease. The Department of Anomalous Diseases has designated SCP-9351's disease as Merfault's Disease. Those afflicted by it will report plantlike growths underneath the skin, typically in the subcutaneous layer. The flora will then grow outward, breaching the epidermis and blossoming into further SCP-9351 insta

SCP-9352 is a cadaver. The object's physical properties cannot be confirmed due to its anomalous nature.
Every organization which has performed an autopsy on SCP-9352 has yielded results which contradict prior reports. However, subsequent inspections by the same organization yield consistent information with that organization's prior findings.
This effect is believed to extend to casual observation of the anomaly, but further testing has not been performed due to ethical considerations.

data.titleJP: Burnam Wood Will Come To Foundation
data.descriptionExcerpt:
SCP-9353 is a phenomenon in which a tree (regardless of species) gains sentience akin to that of a wild animal's. Affected subjects are able to spread SCP-9353 to other trees through direct contact, typically through the roots. The origin of SCP-9353 is unknown.
After 24 hours of being affected, subjects gain the ability to uproot themselves and move around (known as a relocation event). The frequency of their movement is seemingly random, as the long intervals between relocation events has made

The specific poem being recited.

The label of the notebook, most notably the title line, has been scratched off entirely. The pages of SCP-9358 contain writing in the form of undated diary entries, each written in pen ink.

Subject's immediate family, consisting of his parents, a wife, and two sons, reside in his hometown of Noakhali District, Chattogram, Bangladesh.

All is wrong. I will open its containment chamber and the world will be as it should be, and none will have noticed that they forgot it to begin with. Within every room will be a fifth wall, and the world will be right.

Occasionally, carrying out SCP-9370 may create auditory and visual hallucinations of a humanoid entity. These persist during the duration of SCP-9370 despite the use of protective measures, yet do not result in lasting harm.

Though exact details of how they accomplish this are currently unknown, SCP-9376 do not appear to be capable of affecting substances, items, or entities any heavier than the instance’s weight.

The principal anomaly is a three-day temporal desynchronization event, triggered by an unknown interaction between the nuclear reactor powering the ship and an extratemporal phenomenon. The time experienced is relative to the interior of the ship, moving three times slower compared to exterior time.

SCP-9378 is a inanimate bassinet1. It measures 14x26 in/36x72 cm and weighs 13/6 kgs.
SCP-9378's primary anomalous property manifests upon the use of a kinetohazard/kinetoglyph combination, triggered when it is rocked and the phrase "Baby Blue" is repeated thrice. On the third repetition, mental and physical effects manifest in the individual, such as decreased parental attachment and increased sense of dread.

SCP-9380 refers to the lesser deity of violence, chaos, and firearms that you will meet - known as 'Lord Vanaman.' SCP-9380 ontologically opposes ordered structures, seeking to break all order. You will be sacrificed to sate this urge.
Followers of SCP-9380-1, or 'Vanamanism,' depict SCP-9380 through statues or artworks as a humanoid rhesus macaque (Macaca mulatta) with 12 hands, assumed to be a simplified depiction. Furthermore, most records of SCP-9380 and SCP-9380-1 religious practices come f

SCP-9383's light is able to penetrate organic material as well, causing SCP-9383-1 to begin to grow from the microplastics found within the bodies of humans as well as other organisms.

SCP-9384 is a humanoid entity possessing teleportation abilities, with the given name "Johnny Mendoza". Currently, SCP-9384 uses its ability to work as a freelance commercial truck and bus driver under the branding "Johnny-On-The-Spot".
Commercial delivery businesses can solicit SCP-9384 through its website, designated SCP-9384-A. The website will contact the solicitor over email1, allowing them to arrange contracts, negotiate payment, and obtain a date and time for SCP-9384's services.

It has been constructed under Overseer command with the expressed purpose of countering an unspecified pluripotent3 antimemetic4 entity, hereafter designated SCP-9385-A.

SCP-9386 appears to possess sapience, as well as the ability to form coherent speech utilizing its non-anomalous mimicry capabilities. A small metal placard affixed to SCP-9389's back door reads "SCP Foundation Department of Abnormalities"; this door opens to a small CCTV control room designated SCP-9389-A.

The exact appearance of SCP-9390 varies from subject to subject, though all reports are similar enough to warrant designation. Additionally, SCP-9390-1 and SCP-9390-2 are also consistent in behavior across manifestations.

Total control of the motion of one (1) object within sight, akin to general conventions of "telekinesis". Requires concentration.
Alteration of size, ranging between 0.4 mm and 144 m. Requires a constant, conscious effort.

Persons who enter SCP-9393 vanish when they enter the anomaly. This disappearance lasts at least two minutes. There is no known upper limit. If and when a subject returns, they will emerge from the opposite side of the door from which they entered. At current date, the

This avatar takes the form of a large2 baseball, sporting a cape to denote its back, as well as a pair of human eyes and set of human teeth to denote its front. It is diffused throughout the body, but concentrated largely in the heart, tear ducts, and thighs.

It is unknown how an individual comes to be infected by SCP-9399; however, it is highly likely that the manifestation of SCP-9399 is caused by exposure to both SCP-Ψ-3325 and SCP-α-2311. Diagnosis of infected individuals is exceedingly difficult and requires clear proof of a sudden change in attitude towards the use of force in containment.

It appeared at a depth of 475 metres below sea level in Beaufort's Dyke, an ocean trench approximately 21km off the Western coast of Scotland and 19km from the Eastern coast of Northern Ireland on the 14th of August 1969. SCP-9800 is the provisional designation for an anomalous event that led to the transformation of a large area of land, entirely encompassing Site-618, into a contiguous rice paddy field. Attempts to re-establish communication with the Site have been unsuccessful. With the exception of a Dr. Felix Bowie, all Site-618 personnel have been considered MIA.
A temporary outpost has been established within the vicinity of Site-618 to support investigation efforts, which are presently ongoing.

The following are a collection of facts. Not all of these facts are relevant to SCP-9801, as some have been added as obfuscation for the sake of security and personnel safety.





Facts are true information about an entity.








Human memory has both physical and noöspheric components. Typically, the physical component governs the structure of the noöspheric component.








There are Foundation small-scale containment facilities located on the Marianas Trench in the Pacific Ocean.

SCP-9802 is an outdoor air-conditioning unit which is sentient and proficient in American English. How SCP-9802 vocalizes is currently unknown, and it does not display fluency in any language except its current dialect. Otherwise, SCP-9802 is completely non-anomalous.

SCP-9803 is a phenomenon that manifests as an internet advertisement. Instances have appeared across a wide range of websites, with little correlation between site content or viewer demographic, aside from affected websites hosting low quality "chumbox"-style clickbait advertisements.

In order for SCP-9804 to display anomalous properties, the following must be true:

SCP-9804 must be held by the handle.

The photo reel containing evidence of the apparition was first located by the US Military following abnormal reporting emerging from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Foundation personnel have yet to determine how to access this port; attempts to utilize other anomalies, including SCP-005, have been unsuccessful.1

SCP-9835 appeared to only be 30m tall when observed from the outside but its true height was estimated at 3048m.
SCP-9835 currently lays in ruin, with very little of the structure remaining. Following 2016/05/23, all anomalous activity has ceased.

Upon entering SCP-9943-1, the subject will be immediately propelled outward by an unknown force away from the center of the crater, reaching significant, non-lethal speeds. As of writing, the global population is reported as approaching nine billion humans. In actuality, the Foundation estimates the true population as being no higher than four billion, and likely lower.

The phrase "Oh, lost sheep blinded by false light, for you I shed my blood, for you I died" is written on the cassette with a white marker. SCP-9958 is a source of unique cognitohazards that are referred to as the "Words of Wisdom" by the entities related to the anomaly. Research into the specific nature of these cognitohazards is ongoing.

Observed hosts include: Heads of State, Corporate Executives, Military Officials, Celebrities, Religious Leaders and Financial Authorities.
SCP-9960 appears capable of inhabiting only one individual at a time. Habitation periods range between 3 and 5 months before spontaneous departure occur

SCP-9966 is the night sky as observed from the surface of Earth. When instances of SCP-9966 digital or physical are viewed with the unaided human eye or through unaltered optical instruments located on Earth’s surface, or a dataset bearing the signature of SCP-9966 is read by a sufficiently sentient artificial intelligence model, the arrangement of stellar bodies constitutes a memetic phenomenon. This effect is not present when the same pattern is observed from outside Earth’s atmosphere.

data.objectClass: Pending Special Containment Procedures The full current layout of SCP-7719 is to be determined and recorded. Special Containment Procedures will be updated if containment challenges arise. Description SCP-7719 is SCP Foundation Site+19.Unknown relation to Site-19., an underground facility of unknown origin and location. Architecture and interior decoration are in line with Department of Design's parameters for compact sites, save the substandard lighting system. SCP-7719 continually expands at an indeterminate rate. As of writing, SCP-7719 has four underground floors. Addendum 7719.1 Each floor contains from two to four rooms of various utilities. The following is a list of the rooms on each floor and description thereof, as well as its contents, if possible. Floor B4 Room Two A standard Foundation conference room. Several bloody right handprints are strewn across the walls. All members of the Overseer Council (excluding O5-13) are seated in the room. Room One A standard Foundation conference room. Shattered pieces of metallic and red crystalline materials are laid on the table. Floor B3 Room Three A large storage room.Room size noticeably exceeds external physical dimensions. containing various miscellaneous items, such as a bronze humanoid statue, several pink plastic lawn flamingos, an oily mass of flesh, among others. Room Two A manager office room belonging to Ronald Stimson, as written on the name plate. There is no indication of the office ever having been occupied or used. Room One An empty, charred room. Entering it inflicts a slight feeling of wanderlust. Floor B2 All four rooms are densely packed with coffins.Faint smells of sulfur are noted. and can not be entered. Signs on the doors read "Disposal Joint currently at capacity. Refer to Mount Qomolangma Long-term Storage Facility." Floor B1 Room Two A display room, showcasing a scale model of Prototype Site-19/█████████ ████████████████ Research Facility. Several cabinets line the far wall, containing empty casefiles belonging to "Lieutenant M." Room One A studio filled with various supplies and miscellaneous items, such as spray paint, concrete mix, blueprints and blank HMCL ID cards. At the center of the room rests a blank canvas with the word "SORRY" written on it. Ground Floor The ground floor comprises a long tunnel, connecting the facility's entrance to the stairs leading below. The pipes and wirings on the overhang are affixed with small, metallic dodecahedron shells. Ground floor intake tunnel. The entrance leads outside. The entrance lacks any identifiable markings barring a small metal plaque above the doorway, unreadable due to wear and tarnish. SCP-7719 is SCP Foundation Site+19.Unknown relation to Site-19., an underground facility of unknown origin and location. Architecture and interior decoration are in line with Department of Design's parameters for compact sites, save the substandard lighting system.
SCP-7719 continually expands at an indeterminate rate. As of writing, SCP-7719 has four underground floors.

SCP-8000-EX refers to anomalous effects produced from interacting with fantasy-based 'wargames' such as Dungeons & Dragons and Call of Cthulhu. Specifically, SCP-8000-EX refers to a form of cognitive decline wherein certain individuals who play these games cease to be able to distinguish reality from the world depicted by a fantasy wargame. This effect is most prevalent among men aged 15-25.
Documented symptoms of SCP-8000-EX include:

SCP-8472-EX refers to the various body parts comprising the remains of a brown rat (Rattus norvegicus). On December 23rd, 2023, the rat entered Site-333's on-site break room and suddenly exploded, covering the break room in a then-unidentified liquid. Footage of the event is provided below.

SCP-8900 is a complex perceptual phenomenon affecting the visible spectrum which seems to be spread by contact. It can be photographed using certain newly developed techniques, however, the process of photographing the anomaly seems to result in faster spread of its effect, and is considered inadvisable.
